title: Asymmetric catchup scratch: managerial prep for Ravi (weekly)
content:
Purpose: lightweight, manager-driven weekly check to remove blockers, calibrate priorities, and surface any signals I should escalate. This is intentionally asymmetric: I lead with observations + specific asks so Ravi can stay focused on execution.

Context / recent signals:
- Ravi shipped KV-cache fix (INF-4082) last week; post-deploy latency samples look mostly stable but 95th percentile still spikes on long sequences. Need deeper sampling/trace next week.
- Ravi asked for more ownership on deployment rollouts; expressed interest in mentoring on cross-team communication.
- Two PRs in review blocking feature branch: PR#1498 (serve mapreduce batching) + PR#1502 (quantization unit tests). CI flakiness on GPU nodes persists (intermittent segfaults).

Primary agenda (30m total, timeboxed):
1) Quick status (3m) — what shipped, what regressed, any hot tickets?
2) Blocker deep-dive (10m) — CI segfaults + 95p latency spikes: hypothesis, short experiments, who to escalate to (SRE / infra ops).
3) Roadmap micro-decision (7m) — ready to opt-in canary for batching PR? tradeoffs if we delay one release cycle.
4) Career / growth check (6m) — mentoring ask, stretch project pitch, feedback loop.
5) Actions and next steps (4m) — owners and deadlines.

Signals I want Ravi to bring (explicit ask):
- One-line hypothesis for the 95p spikes and the top two experiments to validate (<=3 lines each).
- CI reproduction steps (minimal repro) or note if not reproducible locally.
- Readout of team bandwidth this sprint (who is PTO, who is overloaded).

Coach-style prompts / sample questions I'll use:
- "If we can't root-cause the spike this sprint, what fallback keeps user-facing latency within SLO and minimizes cost?"
- "Who on infra do you want me to loop in, and what ask should I make on your behalf?"
- "What's a small stretch you want to take on in the next 6 weeks that helps your promotion narrative?"

Notes / nudges to self (things I should not forget to do):
- Bring the SRE rotation matrix PDF and highlight who owns GPU CI health this month.
- Offer to unblock dev environment access for X to reproduce segfaults.
- Remember to ask about energy levels — avoid piling on more intensity if Ravi is low bandwidth.

Concrete open issues to resolve in this meeting:
- CI segfault triage owner (proposed: Marcus from infra) — action: I will ping Marcus if Ravi confirms repro by EOD Thu.
- Canary decision for batching PR (PR#1498) — options: A) canary to 10% for 24h, B) hold until quantization tests pass. Decision criteria: canary if infra is confident; otherwise hold.
- Mentorship matching — action: suggest pairing with Ivy for cross-team comms; set up 1 sync next week.

Draft action items (assign during meeting)
- Ravi: produce one-paragraph hypothesis + experiment plan for latency spikes by Fri 2026-04-16.
- Anita (me): if repro confirmed, loop Marcus and escalate to infra on same day.
- Ravi: add minimal repro steps for CI segfaults to GH issue INF-4127 by Thu 2026-04-15 5pm PT.
- Anita: propose pairing session with Ivy and drop calendar invite for next Tue 10am.
- Team: freeze rollout for quantized variant until PR#1502 tests stabilize OR proceed with canary if infra gives green light.

Post-meeting follow-up template (for Slack + email):
- Slack DM to Ravi: "Great sync — I captured actions. I'll ping Marcus once you confirm repro; I'll also schedule pairing with Ivy. Let me know if priorities shift. — Anita"
- Email to infra (if escalation): subject: "[Escalation] GPU CI segfault repro for serving-runtime (INF-4127)" body: one-paragraph summary + repro link + ask to triage.

Mental checklist for tone and frame:
- Keep the meeting outcome-oriented and short. Avoid drifting into low-level debugging in the 1:1; instead get hypothesis and experiments and delegate deep triage to a dedicated session with Marcus/Ivy.
- Frame career conversation around concrete behaviors and next steps; avoid generalities.

Things I want to watch after the meeting (signals to follow up within 48–72h):
- Ravi posted repro in INF-4127.
- Marcus ack + triage plan in Slack.
- Canary metrics if we opt-in: 95p latency, error rate, and token throughput for first 24h.

Unresolved questions to raise if time permits:
- Is there a better observable we can add to the runtime to make 95p spikes more actionable? (e.g., per-layer mem alloc trace)
- Is the current batching policy too conservative for real-time endpoints? who owns tuning it?

Random scratch/fragments (notes to refine into issues after meeting):
- Consider one-off experiment: disable short-sequence aggregation for 95p tests to isolate long-seq path.
- Add regression test that runs on scaled long-sequence simulation in CI (nightly).
- Capture user's complaint thread from support as context (link in INF-4082).

If meeting ends early (5–7 minutes extra):
- Quick shoutout: positive reinforcement for pushing PR#1498 through review.
- Ask if Ravi wants me to connect him to product for rollout planning.

Versioning and notes history: 
- v0.1 (2026-04-10): initial scratch agenda.
- v0.2 (2026-04-13): added CI/PR links and tightened action timelines after quick pre-sync with Ivy.

Bottom line (one sentence to summarize intention):
- Leave the meeting with a clear next-step experiment for the latency spike, a repro or escalation path for CI, and a concrete short-term mentoring plan for Ravi.
